method.scope: All 356 manifest files checked for existence; each prior app page checked independently with subset comparisons; reference and claim registries checked by stable ID; actual current navigation executed and compared with prior destinations.
method.parser: Installed TypeScript AST; JSX id/referenceId/claimId attributes, literal object id/referenceId/claimId fields, explicit [[ref:...]] tokens and literal reference-detail paths.
method.dynamicValues: Dynamic JSX expressions are compared structurally after whitespace normalization. Object IDs are candidates for data-driven anchors, not assumed to be rendered DOM IDs.
method.counts: Page totals count distinct values per file and sum across files. They are not site-wide unique identifier counts.
method.limits: This is a source-preservation audit, not a semantic equivalence or rendered-anchor guarantee. Browser, build, reference-validation and registry-validation checks are separate. Content may be expanded or reorganized while the prior anchors and references remain.

navigation.home: Preserved through the localized logo link

aboutTabs.validation: Same current destinations checked against getAboutRoutes by the 52-test navigation suite; all five locale variants covered.
